title: Keyboard operation – Toasts & notifications at 1280 px
preconditions: Logged in with the seeded mocked user (QA logs in); dark theme
steps:
1. Using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc and arrow keys, operate every control on the screen
2. Open and close every modal, menu, dropdown and drawer
3. After each toggle/modal/drawer closes, check where focus lands (document.activeElement)
expected_result: Every control reachable and operable by keyboard in a logical order; no keyboard trap except intended modal focus trap; Esc closes overlays; focus moves to the new control when a control replaces itself (e.g. Hide → Show Steps) and returns to the trigger when an overlay closes; skip link works

title: Visual parity – Toast component (1398:118791) (380×45)
preconditions: Logged in with the seeded mocked user (QA logs in); dark theme
steps:

2. Measure size, padding, radius, shadow/blur, typography, colours and icon sizes
3. Overlay a Figma export at the same scale (brightness raised to reveal subtle edges)
expected_result: Matches Figma 380×45: same sizes/spacing (±1 px), type style, colours (ΔE ≤ 2 by pixel sample), icons and effects; Figma frames are 1440 wide.
